title: Practical Runtime Enforcement of First-Order Temporal Requirements
title_zh: 一阶时序要求的实用运行时强制执行

paragraphs.en: Runtime enforcers observe a system’s behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements. Many natural requirements not only formulate restrictions on the system’s present behavior, but also impose obligations on its future behavior; for instance, agentic security may require personal data collected during a run to be erased by some deadline. In an ever-growing compliance landscape, real-world systems may be subject to hundreds of such requirements. However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时执行器会观察系统的行为，并对其实行控制，以确保系统始终遵守其要求。 许多自然要求不仅对系统的当前行为设定限制，还对其未来行为施加义务；例如，智能体安全可能要求在某个运行期间收集的个人数据必须在特定截止日期前被删除。 在合规要求不断增长的背景下，现实中的系统可能需要满足数百个此类要求。 然而，支持复杂策略的现有执行机制通常运行速度过慢，无法满足生产软件的需求；因此，开发者可能会转而使用非时间性的访问控制机制和临时性工具，但这些方法在应对复杂要求时扩展性极差。

sents.en: Runtime enforcers observe a system’s behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements.
sents.zh: 运行时执行器会观察系统的行为，并对其实行控制，以确保系统始终遵守其要求。

sents.en: However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity.
sents.zh: 然而，支持复杂策略的现有执行机制通常运行速度过慢，无法满足生产软件的需求；因此，开发者可能会转而使用非时间性的访问控制机制和临时性工具，但这些方法在应对复杂要求时扩展性极差。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we introduce an efficient algorithm and tool for enforcing complex temporal requirements and demonstrate its performance. Specifically, we identify a fragment of Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) that can be enforced with low runtime complexity while supporting a rich family of practically relevant requirements, including obligations. We then design an enforcement algorithm for this fragment and implement it in EnfFlash , a novel tool that enforces requirements with latency up to 44 × 44\times lower than EnfGuard , the previous state-of-the-art enforcer, on standard benchmarks, and up to three orders of magnitude lower on security policies for LLM agents. This performance is achieved by compiling requirements into imperative programs that we efficiently interpret. We evaluate EnfFlash both standalone, on existing benchmarks, and integrated in web applications as an enforcement backend. We demonstrate that it can enforce a substantial 400-line MFOTL formula specifying the GDPR on a social network while adding under 15 ms to each page view, which is sufficient for most interactive and real-time applications.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种高效的算法和工具，用于强制执行复杂的时序要求，并展示了其性能表现。 具体而言，我们识别出了度量一阶时序逻辑（MFOTL）的一个片段，该片段能够在低运行时复杂度的情况下被强制执行，同时支持一系列丰富的、具有实际意义的要求，包括义务性要求。 接着，我们为这一片段设计了一种强制执行算法，并将其实现于 EnfFlash 中——这是一款全新的工具，在标准基准测试中，其执行延迟较此前最先进的强制执行工具 EnfGuard 最多可降低 44 倍，而在针对大型语言模型智能体的安全策略中，延迟最多可降低三个数量级。 这种性能表现通过将要求编译为指令式程序而实现，我们随后对这些程序进行高效解释。 我们对 EnfFlash 进行了全面评估：既在现有基准测试中独立运行，也将其作为强制执行后端集成到网络应用程序中。 我们证明，EnfFlash 能够在社交网络上强制执行一个包含 400 行的复杂 MFOTL 公式（该公式用于规范《通用数据保护条例》），而每次页面浏览的延迟增加不到 15 毫秒，这对于大多数交互式应用和实时应用而言已完全足够。

paragraphs.en: Modern systems must comply with increasingly complex requirements and regulations. Rather than auditing these requirements ex post, in runtime enforcement ( Schneider, 2000 ; Bauer et al., 2002 ) an enforcer observes the system’s behavior and ensures compliance at runtime by suppressing or causing system actions.
paragraphs.zh: 现代系统必须遵守日益复杂的规范和法规。 与其事后审计这些规范，不如在运行时执行（Schneider, 2000；Bauer 等，2002）：执行器会观察系统的行为，并通过抑制或引发系统动作来确保系统在运行时符合规范。

sents.en: Modern systems must comply with increasingly complex requirements and regulations.
sents.zh: 现代系统必须遵守日益复杂的规范和法规。

sents.en: Rather than auditing these requirements ex post, in runtime enforcement ( Schneider, 2000 ; Bauer et al., 2002 ) an enforcer observes the system’s behavior and ensures compliance at runtime by suppressing or causing system actions.
sents.zh: 与其事后审计这些规范，不如在运行时执行（Schneider, 2000；Bauer 等，2002）：执行器会观察系统的行为，并通过抑制或引发系统动作来确保系统在运行时符合规范。

paragraphs.en: Requirements can be broadly classified as provisions , whose satisfaction depends on past and present system behavior, and obligations , whose satisfaction depends on its future behavior ( Hilty et al., 2005 ) . An example provision is enforcing access to confidential data only when a prior approval was granted, whereas an obligation would be that any temporary copy made of confidential data must be deleted within a given deadline. Both of these requirements are temporal and first-order (i.e., they relate events that carry data, such as file identifiers, across time). However, they require different enforcement capabilities: an enforcer can simply react to an attempted system action to enforce a provision, while it must proactively act to enforce an obligation. Runtime enforcement plays a crucial role in numerous domains such as AI agent security: agent behavior cannot be statically analyzed, but only observed, e.g., as a sequence of tool invocations. The example provision and obligation above readily apply in this context with an enforcer mediating tool invocations to ensure policy compliance and retaining responsibility for pending obligations independently of the agent’s subsequent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 需求可大致分为两类：条款（provisions），其满足取决于系统过去和当前的行为；以及义务（obligations），其满足取决于系统的未来行为（Hilty et al., 2005）。 一个条款的例子是：只有在事先获得批准的情况下，才允许访问机密数据；而一个义务则是：对机密数据制作的任何临时副本都必须在规定的期限内删除。 这两项需求都是时间相关的且属于一级需求（即，它们涉及携带数据的事件，例如文件标识符，随时间推移而发生）。 然而，它们需要不同的执行能力：执行器只需对系统尝试执行的操作做出反应即可执行条款，而执行义务则需要主动采取行动。 运行时执行在诸多领域（如人工智能智能体安全）中起着至关重要的作用：智能体的行为无法通过静态分析确定，而只能通过观察来了解，例如将其视为一系列工具调用序列。 上述条款和义务的示例在此背景下可以直接应用：执行器可通过中介工具调用以确保策略合规，并独立于智能体后续的行为，对尚未履行的义务保持责任。

paragraphs.en: Recent industrial developments reinforce the relevance of temporal first-order requirements for agentic software and put forward enforcement performance as a key challenge for its practical adoption. AWS’s Cedar access-control (AC) mechanism ( Cutler et al., 2024 ) is a fast, non-temporal, first-order enforcer designed for a very limited set of provisions: those that depend only on the current system state without considering its past behavior. To alleviate this limitation, AWS recently proposed Dogwood ( Brooker et al., ) , which combines Cedar with Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) ( Chomicki, 1995 ) to express provisions. While MFOTL offers both past and future temporal operators to express both complex provisions and obligations, Dogwood only supports provisions, with obligations identified as future work.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工业发展进一步凸显了时序一阶要求对于智能体软件的重要性，并将执行性能作为其实际应用的关键挑战。 AWS 的 Cedar 访问控制（AC）机制（Cutler 等，2024）是一种快速、非时序的一阶执行器，专为非常有限的条款集而设计：这些条款仅依赖当前系统状态，不考虑其过往行为。 为缓解这一局限性，AWS 最近提出了 Dogwood（Brooker 等，），它将 Cedar 与度量一阶时序逻辑（MFOTL）（Chomicki，1995）相结合，以表达相关条款。 尽管 MFOTL 提供了过去和未来的时序算子，能够表达复杂的条款和义务，但 Dogwood 仅支持条款，而义务则被识别为未来的工作方向。

sents.en: Recent industrial developments reinforce the relevance of temporal first-order requirements for agentic software and put forward enforcement performance as a key challenge for its practical adoption.
sents.zh: 近期的工业发展进一步凸显了时序一阶要求对于智能体软件的重要性，并将执行性能作为其实际应用的关键挑战。

sents.en: To alleviate this limitation, AWS recently proposed Dogwood ( Brooker et al., ) , which combines Cedar with Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) ( Chomicki, 1995 ) to express provisions.
sents.zh: 为缓解这一局限性，AWS 最近提出了 Dogwood（Brooker 等，），它将 Cedar 与度量一阶时序逻辑（MFOTL）（Chomicki，1995）相结合，以表达相关条款。

sents.zh: 尽管 MFOTL 提供了过去和未来的时序算子，能够表达复杂的条款和义务，但 Dogwood 仅支持条款，而义务则被识别为未来的工作方向。

paragraphs.en: Other enforcers based on MFOTL, like EnfGuard ( Hublet et al., 2025b ) and WhyEnf ( Hublet et al., 2024 ) support both provisions and obligations. Unfortunately, these tools’ latency is high and can grow with the size of the enforcer’s state. This leads to latencies of the order of seconds even for relatively simple requirements, making these tools unsuitable for interactive and real-time applications.
paragraphs.zh: 其他基于 MFOTL 的执行器，例如 EnfGuard（Hublet 等人，2025b）和 WhyEnf（Hublet 等人，2024），同时支持规定和义务。 遗憾的是，这些工具的延迟较高，并且会随着执行器状态规模的增大而增加。 这导致即使对于相对简单的需求，延迟也可能达到数秒量级，使得这些工具不适用于交互式应用和实时应用。

sents.en: Other enforcers based on MFOTL, like EnfGuard ( Hublet et al., 2025b ) and WhyEnf ( Hublet et al., 2024 ) support both provisions and obligations.
sents.zh: 其他基于 MFOTL 的执行器，例如 EnfGuard（Hublet 等人，2025b）和 WhyEnf（Hublet 等人，2024），同时支持规定和义务。

sents.en: Unfortunately, these tools’ latency is high and can grow with the size of the enforcer’s state.
sents.zh: 遗憾的是，这些工具的延迟较高，并且会随着执行器状态规模的增大而增加。

sents.en: This leads to latencies of the order of seconds even for relatively simple requirements, making these tools unsuitable for interactive and real-time applications.
sents.zh: 这导致即使对于相对简单的需求，延迟也可能达到数秒量级，使得这些工具不适用于交互式应用和实时应用。

paragraphs.en: An alternative to off-the-shelf enforcers is to directly implement ad-hoc, specialized ones to achieve good performance. However, this is brittle and scales poorly. Abandoning declarative specifications of provisions and obligations, underpinned with formal semantics, introduces a new problem: justifying that the ad-hoc implementation behaves as intended requires reasoning about the much more complex and often unavailable formal semantics of the implementation language. This, combined with the fact that in practice one must implement hundreds of interacting requirements and encode their temporal dependencies by hand, makes this error-prone and hard to evolve ( Nguyễn et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 除了使用现成的执行智能体之外，另一种方法是直接实现临时性、专门化的智能体，以实现良好的性能。 然而，这种方法脆弱且扩展性差。 放弃对条款和义务的声明式规范（这些规范以形式语义为基础）会引入一个新问题：要证明临时性实现能够按预期运行，就需要对实现语言中更为复杂且通常无法获取的形式语义进行推理。 再加上实践中必须实现数百个相互作用的约束条件，并手动编码其时间依赖关系，这使得这种方法容易出错且难以演进（Nguyễn 等人，2026）。

sents.en: An alternative to off-the-shelf enforcers is to directly implement ad-hoc, specialized ones to achieve good performance.
sents.zh: 除了使用现成的执行智能体之外，另一种方法是直接实现临时性、专门化的智能体，以实现良好的性能。

sents.en: However, this is brittle and scales poorly.
sents.zh: 然而，这种方法脆弱且扩展性差。

paragraphs.en: To improve upon the status quo, software developers need a tool that combines three properties: declarative specifications of data-dependent provisions and obligations, sound generation of reactive and proactive enforcement, and runtime performance efficient enough for interactive applications, which require response times on the order of fractions of a second.
paragraphs.zh: 为了改善现状，软件开发人员需要一种兼具以下三种特性的工具：对数据依赖的条款和义务进行声明式规范、可靠地生成反应性和主动性执行机制，以及具备足够高效的运行时性能，以满足交互式应用的需求——这些应用要求响应时间仅为几分之一秒。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce EnfFlash , a novel tool for enforcing first-order temporal provisions and obligations with low, predictable latency. Unlike previous tools, which interpret MFOTL formulae directly ( Hublet et al., 2022 ; Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) , EnfFlash compiles each formula into a program of a small imperative language, EF, that describes an efficient enforcer for that formula, and then executes it. The generated programs are provably correct, and their execution complexity can be statically bounded. The MFOTL fragment supported by EnfFlash is large enough to express a large collection of provisions and obligations that arise in practice, including requirements involving aggregations and user-defined operators. Additionally, EnfFlash lifts the key limitation of previous enforcers ( Hublet et al., 2022 ; Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) that could not simultaneously cause and suppress the same event with different parameters; its compiler optimizes the order of rule evaluation and fixpoint computations to reduce overhead while preserving soundness.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 EnfFlash——一种用于强制执行一阶时间条款和义务的新工具，其延迟低且可预测。 与以往直接解释 MFOTL 公式的工具（Hublet et al., 2022; Hublet et al., 2024; Hublet et al., 2025b）不同，EnfFlash 会将每个公式编译成一个小型命令式语言 EF 的程序，该程序描述了针对该公式的高效执行器，然后执行该程序。 生成的程序具有可证明的正确性，其执行复杂度也可以静态地界定。 EnfFlash 所支持的 MFOTL 片段足够广泛，能够表达实践中出现的多种条款和义务，包括涉及聚合和用户定义算子的要求。 此外，EnfFlash 克服了以往执行器（Hublet et al., 2022; Hublet et al., 2024; Hublet et al., 2025b）的一个关键限制：它们无法同时触发和抑制具有不同参数的同一事件；其编译器通过优化规则评估顺序和不动点计算的顺序，在保持正确性的同时减少了开销。

sents.en: In this paper, we introduce EnfFlash , a novel tool for enforcing first-order temporal provisions and obligations with low, predictable latency.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 EnfFlash——一种用于强制执行一阶时间条款和义务的新工具，其延迟低且可预测。

sents.en: Unlike previous tools, which interpret MFOTL formulae directly ( Hublet et al., 2022 ; Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) , EnfFlash compiles each formula into a program of a small imperative language, EF, that describes an efficient enforcer for that formula, and then executes it.
sents.zh: 与以往直接解释 MFOTL 公式的工具（Hublet et al., 2022; Hublet et al., 2024; Hublet et al., 2025b）不同，EnfFlash 会将每个公式编译成一个小型命令式语言 EF 的程序，该程序描述了针对该公式的高效执行器，然后执行该程序。

sents.en: The generated programs are provably correct, and their execution complexity can be statically bounded.
sents.zh: 生成的程序具有可证明的正确性，其执行复杂度也可以静态地界定。

sents.en: The MFOTL fragment supported by EnfFlash is large enough to express a large collection of provisions and obligations that arise in practice, including requirements involving aggregations and user-defined operators.
sents.zh: EnfFlash 所支持的 MFOTL 片段足够广泛，能够表达实践中出现的多种条款和义务，包括涉及聚合和用户定义算子的要求。

sents.en: Additionally, EnfFlash lifts the key limitation of previous enforcers ( Hublet et al., 2022 ; Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) that could not simultaneously cause and suppress the same event with different parameters; its compiler optimizes the order of rule evaluation and fixpoint computations to reduce overhead while preserving soundness.
sents.zh: 此外，EnfFlash 克服了以往执行器（Hublet et al., 2022; Hublet et al., 2024; Hublet et al., 2025b）的一个关键限制：它们无法同时触发和抑制具有不同参数的同一事件；其编译器通过优化规则评估顺序和不动点计算的顺序，在保持正确性的同时减少了开销。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate EnfFlash ’s expressivity and performance using existing benchmarks ( Cutler et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) and deploy it as an enforcement backend for two mid-sized web applications: a social network platform instrumented for compliance with a 400-line specification of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and an event management platform accompanied by a broad range of access-control rules. We also enforce security policies on the tool calls of an LLM banking agent under prompt-injection attacks. Compared with EnfGuard ( Hublet et al., 2025b ) , the previous state-of-the-art MFOTL enforcer, EnfFlash ’s latency is 3–44 × \times lower on 17 of the 20 benchmark formulae both process ( EnfGuard times out on 19 others) and 20–5,570 × \times lower on the agent’s policies; in web applications, enforcement adds 1–15 ms per page view, compatible with production use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用现有的基准测试（Cutler 等人，2024；Hublet 等人，2025b）来评估 EnfFlash 的表达力和性能，并将其部署为两个中等规模网络应用的执行后端：一个社交网络平台，该平台已针对符合《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的 400 行规范进行了配置；另一个是附带广泛访问控制规则的活动管理平台。 我们还对 LLM 银行智能体的工具调用在提示注入攻击下执行安全策略。 与 EnfGuard（Hublet 等人，2025b）——即此前最先进的 MFOTL 执行器——相比，EnfFlash 在处理 20 个基准公式中的 17 个时，延迟降低了 3–44 倍（EnfGuard 在其他 19 个公式上出现超时），而在智能体的策略执行上，延迟降低了 20–5,570 倍；在网络应用中，执行操作每次页面查看仅增加 1–15 毫秒的延迟，符合生产环境的使用需求。

paragraphs.en: After reviewing enforcement preliminaries (Section 2 ), we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 在回顾了执行初步工作（第 2 节）之后，我们提出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We design an imperative DSL called EF that captures the behavior of proactive first-order enforcers, give it a formal semantics, and bound EF’s evaluation time complexity (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种名为 EF 的命令式 DSL，用于捕捉主动一阶执行器的行为，并为其定义了形式语义，同时界定了 EF 的评估时间复杂度（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a novel compilation procedure from MFOTL to EF, generating sound enforcers for an expressive fragment of MFOTL (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种从 MFOTL 到 EF 的新型编译过程，为 MFOTL 的一个富有表现力的片段生成可靠的执行器（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We implement our algorithms in EnfFlash , and evaluate it both on existing enforcement benchmarks and as an enforcement backend for web applications and LLM agents. We show that EnfFlash enforces specifications comprising hundreds of requirements with modest latency, with 3 3 – 44 × 44\times lower latency than EnfGuard on most benchmark formulae (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 EnfFlash 中实现了我们的算法，并在现有的执行基准测试以及作为网页应用和 LLM 智能体的执行后端上对其进行了评估。 我们证明，EnfFlash 在执行包含数百个要求的规范时延迟适中，并且在大多数基准公式上的延迟比 EnfGuard 低 3 3 – 44 × 44\times（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Overall, EnfFlash is the first enforcer for first-order temporal provisions and obligations offering practical performance (Section 6 ). All theorems marked with are formally verified in Lean 4 ( Moura and Ullrich, 2021 ) for the core logic presented in this paper; the complexity results in Section 3.3 are proved on paper.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，EnfFlash 是首个针对一阶时间条款和义务的执行器，能够提供实际性能（第 6 节）。 所有带有标记的定理均已通过 Lean 4（Moura 和 Ullrich，2021）对本文提出的核心逻辑进行了形式化验证；而第 3.3 节中的复杂度结果则是通过传统证明方法得出的。

paragraphs.en: We introduce traces that model executions, metric-first order temporal logic (MFOTL), and enforcers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了用于模拟执行的轨迹、指标一阶时态逻辑（MFOTL）以及执行器。

paragraphs.en: Let 𝔼 \mathbb{E} be a finite set of event names with arity function ι : 𝔼 → ℕ \iota:\mathbb{E}\rightarrow\mathbb{N} and 𝔻 \mathbb{D} be a non-empty set of data values . A signature Σ = ( 𝔻 , 𝔼 , ι ) \Sigma=(\mathbb{D},\mathbb{E},\iota) defines the set of databases 𝔻 𝔹 ≔ 𝒫 ( { ( e , d ¯ ) ∣ e ∈ 𝔼 , d ¯ ∈ 𝔻 ι ⁡ ( e ) } ) . \mathbb{DB}\coloneqq\mathcal{P}(\{(e,\bar{d})\mid e\in\mathbb{E},\bar{d}\in\mathbb{D}^{\iota(e)}\}). For E ⊆ 𝔼 E\subseteq\mathbb{E} , let 𝔻 𝔹 E ≔ { D ∈ 𝔻 𝔹 ∣ ∀ ( e , d ¯ ) ∈ D . e ∈ E } \mathbb{DB}_{E}\coloneqq\{D\in\mathbb{DB}\mid\forall(e,\bar{d})\in D.\ e\in E\} denote databases with event names in E E .
paragraphs.zh: 令 𝔼 \mathbb{E} 为一个有限的事件名称集合，其元数函数为 ι : 𝔼 → ℕ \iota:\mathbb{E}\rightarrow\mathbb{N}，并令 𝔻 \mathbb{D} 为一个非空的数据值集合。 一个签名 Σ = ( 𝔻 , 𝔼 , ι ) \Sigma=(\mathbb{D},\mathbb{E},\iota) 定义了数据库集合 𝔻 𝔹 ≔ 𝒫 ( { ( e , d ¯ ) ∣ e ∈ 𝔼 , d ¯ ∈ 𝔻 ι ⁡ ( e ) } ) 。 \mathbb{DB}\coloneqq\mathcal{P}(\{(e,\bar{d})\mid e\in\mathbb{E},\bar{d}\in\mathbb{D}^{\iota(e)}\}). 对于 E ⊆ 𝔼 E\subseteq\mathbb{E}，令 𝔻 𝔹 E ≔ { D ∈ 𝔻 𝔹 ∣ ∀ ( e , d ¯ ) ∈ D . e ∈ E } \mathbb{DB}_{E}\coloneqq\{D\in\mathbb{DB}\mid\forall(e,\bar{d})\in D.\ e\in E\} 表示事件名称属于 E E 的数据库。

paragraphs.en: Consider a file management system. Files can be accessed (‘used’) or deleted, and users can request deletion of their data, give consent for files of some category to be used, or revoke said consent. We model this with the signature Σ 0 = ( ℕ , 𝔼 0 , ι 0 ) \Sigma_{0}=(\mathbb{N},\mathbb{E}_{0},\iota_{0}) , where 𝔼 0 = { 𝗎𝗌𝖾 , 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 , 𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾 , 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾 , 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 ​ _ ​ 𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍 } \mathbb{E}_{0}=\{\mathsf{use},\mathsf{consent},\allowbreak\mathsf{revoke},\allowbreak\mathsf{delete},\allowbreak\mathsf{deletion\_request}\} , ι 0 ​ ( 𝗎𝗌𝖾 ) = 3 \iota_{0}(\mathsf{use})=3 , and ι 0 ​ ( 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾 ) = ι 0 ​ ( 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 ​ _ ​ 𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍 ) = ι 0 ​ ( 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 ) = ι 0 ​ ( 𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾 ) = 2 \iota_{0}(\mathsf{delete})=\iota_{0}(\mathsf{deletion\_request})=\iota_{0}(\mathsf{consent})=\iota_{0}(\mathsf{revoke})=2 . The event 𝗎𝗌𝖾 ⁡ ( c , d , u ) \mathsf{use}(c,d,u) denotes ‘system uses user u u ’s data d d from category c c ’, 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾 ⁡ ( d , u ) \mathsf{delete}(d,u) denotes ‘user u u ’s data d d is deleted’, 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 ​ _ ​ 𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍 ​ ( d , u ) \mathsf{deletion\_request}(d,u) denotes ‘user u u requests deletion of data d d ’, 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 ⁡ ( u , c ) \mathsf{consent}(u,c) denotes ‘user u u provides consent for category c c ’, and 𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾 ⁡ ( u , c ) \mathsf{revoke}(u,c) denotes ‘user u u revokes consent for category c c ’.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个文件管理系统。 文件可以被访问（“使用”）或删除，用户可以请求删除自己的数据，同意使用某一类别的文件，或撤销该同意。 我们用签名 Σ₀ = (ℕ, 𝔼₀, ι₀) 来对此进行建模，其中 𝔼₀ = {𝗎𝗌𝖾, 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍, 𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾, 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾, 𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇_𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍}，ι₀(𝗎𝗌𝖾) = 3，且 ι₀(𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾) = ι₀(𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇_𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍) = ι₀(𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍) = ι₀(𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾) = 2。 事件 𝗎𝗌𝖾(c, d, u) 表示“系统使用用户 u 的数据 d，该数据属于类别 c”；𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝖾(d, u) 表示“用户 u 的数据 d 被删除”；𝖽𝖾𝗅𝖾𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇_𝗋𝖾𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍(d, u) 表示“用户 u 请求删除数据 d”；𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍(u, c) 表示“用户 u 同意使用类别 c 的数据”；而 𝗋𝖾𝗏𝗈𝗄𝖾(u, c) 表示“用户 u 撤销对类别 c 的同意”。

paragraphs.en: MFOTL extends First-Order Logic (FOL) with temporal operators ○ \mathop{\Circle}\nolimits (‘next’), ● \mathop{\CIRCLE}\nolimits (‘previous’), ◊ \operatorname{\lozenge} (‘eventually’) and 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}} (‘since’) ( Pnueli, 1977 ) equipped with intervals ( Koymans, 1990 ) that encode constraints on timestamps. We also include let bindings that introduce intermediate definitions, as well as SQL-style and user-defined aggregations. We thus follow Hublet et al. ( Hublet et al., 2025b ) , except for the 𝖴 \mathbin{\mathsf{U}} (‘until’) operator being replaced by the ◊ \operatorname{\lozenge} operator as a primitive, a deliberate restriction to the fragment we enforce.
paragraphs.zh: MFOTL 在一级逻辑（FOL）的基础上扩展了时间算子 ○ \mathop{\Circle}\nolimits（“下一个”）、● \mathop{\CIRCLE}\nolimits（“前一个”）、◊ \operatorname{\lozenge}（“最终”）和 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}}（“自从”）（Pnueli, 1977），并配备了用于编码时间戳约束的区间（Koymans, 1990）。 我们还引入了 let 绑定，用于创建中间定义，以及 SQL 风格的聚合和用户自定义的聚合。 因此，我们遵循 Hublet 等人提出的方法。 （Hublet et al., 2025b），唯一的例外是 𝖴 \mathbin{\mathsf{U}}（“直到”）算子被替换为 ◊ \operatorname{\lozenge} 算子作为基本算子，这是我们对所强制执行的子集所做的有意限制。

paragraphs.en: Suppose the time unit is days . Consider the following four formulae:
paragraphs.zh: 假设时间单位是“天”。 考虑以下四个公式：

sents.en: Suppose the time unit is days .
sents.zh: 假设时间单位是“天”。

sents.en: Consider the following four formulae:
sents.zh: 考虑以下四个公式：

paragraphs.en: The first formula, φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}} , formalizes the lawfulness of processing : ‘whenever data d d with category c c belonging to user u u is processed, then u u must have consented to the use of category c c at some point in the past and not since revoked that consent.’ The second formula, φ 𝖽𝖾𝗅 \varphi_{\mathsf{del}} , formalizes the GDPR’s right to erasure : ‘whenever a user u u requests the deletion of data d d , then d d must be deleted within 30 days.’ The third formula, φ 𝗅𝖾𝗍 \varphi_{\mathsf{let}} , illustrates let bindings : it defines 𝗁𝖺𝗌 ​ _ ​ 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 ​ ( u , c ) \mathsf{has\_consent}(u,c) as holding when u u has consented to category c c and not revoked that consent, and uses this definition to restate φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}} more concisely. The fourth formula, φ 𝖺𝗀𝗀 \varphi_{\mathsf{agg}} , illustrates aggregations : it counts, grouped by u u , the number of data items of user u u used over the last 10 time units.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个公式 φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}} 将处理的合法性形式化：“每当处理属于用户 u u 且类别为 c c 的数据 d d 时，u u 必须曾在过去某个时间点同意使用类别 c c，且此后未撤销该同意。”第二个公式 φ 𝖽𝖾𝗅 \varphi_{\mathsf{del}} 将《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）中的删除权形式化：“每当用户 u u 请求删除数据 d d 时，则必须在 30 天内删除 d d。”第三个公式 φ 𝗅𝖾𝗍 \varphi_{\mathsf{let}} 说明了 let 绑定：它将 𝗁𝖺𝗌 ​ _ ​ 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 ​ ( u , c ) \mathsf{has\_consent}(u,c) 定义为成立，当且仅当 u u 已同意类别 c c 且未撤销该同意，并利用这一定义更简洁地重述 φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}}。 第四个公式 φ 𝖺𝗀𝗀 \varphi_{\mathsf{agg}} 说明了聚合操作：它按 u u 分组，统计用户 u u 在过去 10 个时间单位内使用过的数据项数量。

sents.en: The first formula, φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}} , formalizes the lawfulness of processing : ‘whenever data d d with category c c belonging to user u u is processed, then u u must have consented to the use of category c c at some point in the past and not since revoked that consent.’ The second formula, φ 𝖽𝖾𝗅 \varphi_{\mathsf{del}} , formalizes the GDPR’s right to erasure : ‘whenever a user u u requests the deletion of data d d , then d d must be deleted within 30 days.’ The third formula, φ 𝗅𝖾𝗍 \varphi_{\mathsf{let}} , illustrates let bindings : it defines 𝗁𝖺𝗌 ​ _ ​ 𝖼𝗈𝗇𝗌𝖾𝗇𝗍 ​ ( u , c ) \mathsf{has\_consent}(u,c) as holding when u u has consented to category c c and not revoked that consent, and uses this definition to restate φ 𝗅𝖺𝗐 \varphi_{\mathsf{law}} more concisely.

paragraphs.en: We consider a proactive runtime enforcement model ( Basin et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2024 ) where non-compliant traces can be corrected in two ways: by modifying existing event databases by causing or suppressing events ( reactively ); or by inserting a single event database before any timestamp increment ( proactively ). The latter feature allows enforcers to satisfy real-time deadlines by inserting events. We assume that a fixed subset of all events can be caused at any time ( ℂ ⊆ 𝔼 \mathbb{C}\subseteq\mathbb{E} ), while another fixed subset can be suppressed ( 𝕊 ⊆ 𝔼 \mathbb{S}\subseteq\mathbb{E} ). Formally, a proactive enforcer is a quadruple ℰ = ( 𝒮 , s 0 , μ , ν ) \mathcal{E}=(\mathcal{S},s_{0},\mu,\nu) where 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is a set of states, s 0 s_{0} is an initial state, μ : 𝒮 × 𝕋 × ℕ × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 → 𝒮 × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 ℂ × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 𝕊 \mu:\mathcal{S}\times\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{DB}\to\mathcal{S}\times\mathbb{DB}_{\mathbb{C}}\times\mathbb{DB}_{\mathbb{S}} updates the state and causes and suppresses events when processing a database, and ν : 𝒮 × 𝕋 × ℕ → 𝒮 × ( 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 ℂ ∪ { ⊥ } ) \nu:\mathcal{S}\times\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{N}\to\mathcal{S}\times(\mathbb{DB}_{\mathbb{C}}\cup\{\bot\}) updates the state and optionally causes events (or does nothing) when a timestamp is incremented. As in ( Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) , the enforcer ℰ \mathcal{E} modifies a trace ρ \rho as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一种主动运行时执行模型（Basin 等，2024；Hublet 等，2024），其中不符合要求的轨迹可以通过两种方式得到修正：通过引发或抑制事件来修改现有的事件数据库（被动方式）；或者在任意时间戳递增之前插入一个单一的事件数据库（主动方式）。后一种特性允许执行器通过插入事件来满足实时截止时间。我们假设所有事件中的一个固定子集可以在任何时刻被引发（ℂ ⊆ 𝔼），而另一个固定子集则可以被抑制（𝕊 ⊆ 𝔼）。形式上，一个主动执行器是一个四元组 ℰ = ( 𝒮 , s 0 , μ , ν )，其中 𝒮 是状态集合，s 0 是初始状态，μ : 𝒮 × 𝕋 × ℕ × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 → 𝒮 × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 ℂ × 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 𝕊 在处理数据库时更新状态，并引发和抑制事件；而 ν : 𝒮 × 𝕋 × ℕ → 𝒮 × ( 𝔻 ​ 𝔹 ℂ ∪ { ⊥ } ) 在时间戳递增时更新状态，并可选择地引发事件（或不执行任何操作）。与（Hublet 等，2024；Hublet 等，2025b）中的做法一致，执行器 ℰ 按如下方式修改轨迹 ρ：

paragraphs.en: The enforcement loop incrementally processes a trace ρ \rho of timestamped events ( τ i , D i ) (\tau_{i},D_{i}) , maintaining a current state s s and an output trace σ \sigma . For each event, it first applies μ \mu to update the state and transform the event’s data (causing and suppressing event in C C and S S ), and then calls ν \nu before any timestamp increment to proactively cause any additional events.
paragraphs.zh: 执行循环逐步处理一个带有时间戳的事件序列 ρ \rho（( τ i , D i ) (\tau_{i},D_{i})），同时维护当前状态 s s 和输出序列 σ \sigma。 对于每个事件，它首先应用 μ \mu 来更新状态并转换事件的数据（在 C C 和 S S 中引发和抑制事件），然后在任何时间戳递增之前调用 ν \nu，以主动引发任何额外的事件。

paragraphs.en: We now present EF, a domain-specific language (DSL) that encodes the behavior of a proactive, first-order enforcer. EF programs are trace transducers that cause and suppress events when specific triggers hold, store temporal relations into tables, and perform fixpoint computations. One key feature of EF programs is that their per-time-point evaluation complexity can be easily bounded in terms of the size of some of their internal tables. If these tables remain small, this provides guarantees that the program’s latency will not significantly grow with trace size, a key feature for deployment in long-running systems. In Havelund et al.’s terminology ( Havelund et al., 2024 ) , EF is an operational specification language with a concrete executable semantics. We present EF’s syntax (Section 3.1 ) and its semantics (Section 3.2 ) and analyze the complexity of executing EF programs (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在介绍 EF，这是一种领域特定语言（DSL），用于编码主动式一阶执行器的行为。 EF 程序是轨迹转换器：当特定触发条件满足时，它们会引发或抑制事件、将时间关系存储到表中，并执行不动点计算。 EF 程序的一个关键特性是，其每个时间点的评估复杂度可以根据某些内部表的大小轻松界定。 如果这些表保持较小，就能保证程序的延迟不会随着轨迹规模的增大而显著增长，这是其在长期运行系统中部署的关键特性。 按照 Havelund 等人（Havelund et al., 2024）的术语，EF 是一种具有具体可执行语义的操作性规范语言。 我们将介绍 EF 的语法（第 3.1 节）和语义（第 3.2 节），并分析执行 EF 程序的复杂度（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: A table stores a persistent finite relation. At every iteration, the interpreter removes the rows matched by its remove clause and inserts those matched by its add clause. A [ window ​ a ​ b ​ ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{window}}\ a\ b\text{]} annotation makes the table metric : rows are active when they were inserted between a a and b b time units in the past ( b = * b=\text{*} denotes ∞ \infty ). A lagged table is consumed in the next iteration instead of the current one and cannot have a remove clause.
paragraphs.zh: 一张表存储一个持久的有限关系。 在每次迭代中，解释器会移除其“移除子句”所匹配的行，并插入其“添加子句”所匹配的行。 一个 [ window a b ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{window}}\ a\ b\text{]} 注释使得表指标如下：当行在 a 和 b 个时间单位之前被插入时，它们处于活跃状态（b = * b=\text{*} 表示 ∞ \infty）。 延迟表在下一轮迭代中被使用，而不是当前迭代，且不能包含“移除子句”。

sents.zh: filter 关键字表示该 let 表达式可能不是有限的，并且只能作为另一个关系上的布尔条件使用。

paragraphs.en: An agg let evaluates its over clause, groups the results by group_by , and applies the operator 𝑜𝑝 \mathit{op} ( SUM , AVG , … {\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{SUM}},{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{AVG}},\dots ) to each group.
paragraphs.zh: 一个聚合智能体会评估其 OVER 子句，按 group_by 对结果进行分组，并对每个组应用运算符 𝑜𝑝 \mathit{op}（SUM、AVG、… {\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{SUM}}、{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{AVG}}、\dots）。

paragraphs.en: A rule matches its trigger to current events and, for each match, triggers an action. The action + causes an event, while - suppresses it. By default, the action is performed at the current time-point. With + , the [ delay ​ n ​ ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{delay}}\ n\text{]} annotation triggers the event proactively in n n time-units, while [ next ​ n ​ ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{next}}\ n\text{]} schedules it in n n time-points.
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则会将其触发条件与当前事件进行匹配，并对每次匹配触发一个动作。 使用 + 表示该动作会引发一个事件，而 - 则表示抑制该事件。 默认情况下，该动作会在当前时间点执行。 使用 + 时，[ delay ​ n ​ ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{delay}}\ n\text{]} 注释会主动在 n 个时间单位后触发该事件，而 [ next ​ n ​ ] \text{[}{\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{next}}\ n\text{]} 则会在 n 个时间点之后安排其执行。

paragraphs.en: A section declaration groups all following rules (until the next section ) into one evaluation block, run either once or to a local fixpoint , i.e., until the set of events obtained via suppressions and causations is stable. Every rule must belong to a section.
paragraphs.zh: 一个章节声明将所有后续规则（直到下一个章节）归入一个评估块，该评估块要么运行一次，要么运行到局部固定点，即通过抑制和因果作用获得的事件集合稳定为止。 每条规则都必须属于某个章节。

paragraphs.en: A clause is a pair of a disjunction π \pi of guards κ 1 , … , κ n \kappa_{1},\dots,\kappa_{n} , n ≥ 0 n\geq 0 , with each guard being a conjunction of atoms, and a filter if ​ φ {\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{if}}\ \varphi . An atom is either a predicate e ⁡ ( t 1 , … , t k ) e(t_{1},\dots,t_{k}) or an equality 𝑖𝑑 ​ == ​ v \mathit{id}\,\text{==}\,v . Without a guard, the clause is reduced to its filter. If there is at least one guard, each free variable of the clause must be the argument of an atom of each guard. Guarded clauses can thus serve as queries over a relation: matching variable assignments are enumerated using the guards, and then filtered.
paragraphs.zh: 一个子句由一个析取式 π \pi 构成，该析取式包含守卫 κ₁, …, κₙ \kappa_{1},\dots,\kappa_{n}（其中 n ≥ 0），每个守卫都是原子的合取式；如果存在 φ {\color[rgb]{0.09,0.37,0.65}\text{if}}\ \varphi，则构成一个过滤器。 原子要么是谓词 e⁡(t₁, …, tₖ) e(t_{1},\dots,t_{k})，要么是相等性 𝑖𝑑 ​==​ v \mathit{id}\,\text{==}\,v。 如果没有守卫，该子句将简化为其过滤器。 如果存在至少一个守卫，则子句中的每个自由变量都必须是每个守卫中某个原子的参数。 因此，带守卫的子句可以用作对关系进行的查询：通过守卫枚举匹配的变量赋值，然后进行过滤。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 defines the semantics of a program P P with definitions d 1 , … , d n d_{1},\dots,d_{n} of predicates p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\dots,p_{n} . The working set 𝒮 = ( T , τ , D , C , S ) \mathcal{S}=(T,\tau,D,C,S) consists of the tables, the current timestamp, the input events, and the events caused and suppressed so far. The tables contain timestamped rows of the form τ ⋅ r \tau\cdot r where τ \tau is a timestamp and r r is a sequence of domain elements. The operator s ¯ I = { a ¯ ∣ τ ′ ⋅ a ¯ ∈ s , τ − τ ′ ∈ I } \overline{s}^{I}=\{\bar{a}\mid\tau^{\prime}\cdot\bar{a}\in s,\ \tau-\tau^{\prime}\in I\} selects the rows of a timestamped relation whose timestamps are within the interval I I . The notation v ↾ x ¯ v{\restriction}_{\bar{x}} denotes the row obtained by projecting v v on x ¯ \bar{x} , i.e., ( v ⁡ ( x 1 ) , … , v ⁡ ( x k ) ) (v(x_{1}),\dots,v(x_{k})) .
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2 定义了程序 P P 的语义，其中包含谓词 p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\dots,p_{n} 的定义 d 1 , … , d n d_{1},\dots,d_{n}。 工作集 𝒮 = ( T , τ , D , C , S ) \mathcal{S}=(T,\tau,D,C,S) 由表、当前时间戳、输入事件以及迄今为止已触发和抑制的事件组成。 这些表包含形如 τ ⋅ r \tau\cdot r 的时间戳行，其中 τ \tau 是一个时间戳，r r 是一个域元素序列。 算子 s ¯ I = { a ¯ ∣ τ ′ ⋅ a ¯ ∈ s , τ − τ ′ ∈ I } \overline{s}^{I}=\{\bar{a}\mid\tau^{\prime}\cdot\bar{a}\in s,\ \tau-\tau^{\prime}\in I\} 用于选择时间戳关系中时间戳位于区间 I I 内的行。 记号 v ↾ x ¯ v{\restriction}_{\bar{x}} 表示通过对 v v 在 x ¯ \bar{x} 上进行投影所得到的行，即 ( v ⁡ ( x 1 ) , … , v ⁡ ( x k ) ) (v(x_{1}),\dots,v(x_{k}))。

paragraphs.en: The reference interpreter consists of four functions. Eval evaluates definitions on the working set. Interp extends R 0 = ( D ∖ S ) ∪ C R_{0}=(D\setminus S)\cup C with the value of each of the p i p_{i} , evaluating definitions in sequence using Eval . Update applies a single rule on the current working set, updating Ω \Omega . Saturate applies rules section-wise (once for a once section, and until ( Ω , C , S ) (\Omega,C,S) reaches a fixed point for fixpoint sections), updates the persistent tables, and returns a new state. Throughout, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} refers to the current values of T T , C C and S S . The reactive function μ \mu simply calls Saturate after retrieving the next obligations due at the current time-point. The proactive ν \nu function first computes the events to be caused at the current timestamp or time-point, identifying obligations that hit their deadline. Then, if and only there exist any such events, it calls the Saturate loop.
paragraphs.zh: 参考解释器由四个函数组成。 Eval 在工作集上评估定义。 Interp 通过依次使用 Eval 评估每个 p_i 的值，将 R_0 = (D \setminus S) \cup C 扩展为 R_{0}=(D\setminus S)\cup C。 Update 在当前工作集上应用一条规则，更新 Ω。 Saturate 按部分应用规则（每个部分仅应用一次，直到 (Ω,C,S) 对固定点部分达到固定点），更新持久表，并返回一个新状态。 在整个过程中，𝒮 表示 T、C 和 S 的当前值。 反应函数 μ 只需在获取当前时间点的下一个待执行义务后调用 Saturate。 主动函数 ν 首先计算在当前时间戳或时间点应触发的事件，识别出已到期的义务。 然后，当且仅当存在此类事件时，它才会调用 Saturate 循环。

sents.en: Interp extends R 0 = ( D ∖ S ) ∪ C R_{0}=(D\setminus S)\cup C with the value of each of the p i p_{i} , evaluating definitions in sequence using Eval .
sents.zh: Interp 通过依次使用 Eval 评估每个 p_i 的值，将 R_0 = (D \setminus S) \cup C 扩展为 R_{0}=(D\setminus S)\cup C。

sents.en: Update applies a single rule on the current working set, updating Ω \Omega .
sents.zh: Update 在当前工作集上应用一条规则，更新 Ω。

sents.en: Saturate applies rules section-wise (once for a once section, and until ( Ω , C , S ) (\Omega,C,S) reaches a fixed point for fixpoint sections), updates the persistent tables, and returns a new state.
sents.zh: Saturate 按部分应用规则（每个部分仅应用一次，直到 (Ω,C,S) 对固定点部分达到固定点），更新持久表，并返回一个新状态。

sents.en: Throughout, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} refers to the current values of T T , C C and S S .
sents.zh: 在整个过程中，𝒮 表示 T、C 和 S 的当前值。

sents.en: The reactive function μ \mu simply calls Saturate after retrieving the next obligations due at the current time-point.
sents.zh: 反应函数 μ 只需在获取当前时间点的下一个待执行义务后调用 Saturate。

sents.en: The proactive ν \nu function first computes the events to be caused at the current timestamp or time-point, identifying obligations that hit their deadline.
sents.zh: 主动函数 ν 首先计算在当前时间戳或时间点应触发的事件，识别出已到期的义务。

sents.en: Then, if and only there exist any such events, it calls the Saturate loop.
sents.zh: 然后，当且仅当存在此类事件时，它才会调用 Saturate 循环。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present an algorithm that generates EF programs enforcing formulae in an expressive fragment of MFOTL. Our generation algorithm consists of four components: a normalization procedure that places all temporal subformulae of a formula behind let bindings ( 4.1 ); rewrite rules that extract guards from subformulae ( 4.2 ); rewrite rules that generate enforceable clauses from a formula ( 4.3 ); and a dependency analysis that decides enforceability of a conjunction of clauses and fixes their evaluation order ( 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们提出一种生成 EF 程序的算法，该程序用于在 MFOTL 的一个表达力强的片段中强制执行公式。 我们的生成算法由四个组件组成：一个归一化过程，它将公式的所有时间子公式置于 let 绑定之后（4.1）；提取子公式中守卫的重写规则（4.2）；从公式生成可执行子句的重写规则（4.3）；以及一个依赖分析，用于判断子句合取的可执行性并确定其求值顺序（4.5）。

sents.zh: 前者依赖于等式 π ∧ φ j ≡ π ′ ∧ φ j ′ ⟹ π ∧ ⋀ i φ i ≡ π ′ ∧ ⋀ i ≠ j φ i ∧ φ j ′ \pi\land\varphi_{j}\equiv\pi^{\prime}\land\varphi^{\prime}_{j}\Longrightarrow\pi\land\bigwedge_{i}\varphi_{i}\equiv\pi^{\prime}\land\bigwedge_{i\neq j}\varphi_{i}\land\varphi^{\prime}_{j}，这使得可以从任何合取项中提取一个守卫。

sents.en: The latter uses the dual equation ∀ i . π → φ i ≡ π i ′ → φ i ′ ⟹ π → ⋀ i φ i ≡ ⋁ i π i ′ → ⋀ i ( π i ′ → φ i ′ ) \forall i.~\pi\to\varphi_{i}\equiv\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\varphi^{\prime}_{i}\Longrightarrow\pi\to\bigwedge_{i}\varphi_{i}\equiv\bigvee_{i}\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\bigwedge_{i}(\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\varphi^{\prime}_{i}) .
sents.zh: 后者使用对偶等式 ∀ i . π → φ i ≡ π i ′ → φ i ′ ⟹ π → ⋀ i φ i ≡ ⋁ i π i ′ → ⋀ i ( π i ′ → φ i ′ ) \forall i.~\pi\to\varphi_{i}\equiv\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\varphi^{\prime}_{i}\Longrightarrow\pi\to\bigwedge_{i}\varphi_{i}\equiv\bigvee_{i}\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\bigwedge_{i}(\pi^{\prime}_{i}\to\varphi^{\prime}_{i})。

paragraphs.en: The two Ev rules are the only rules implementing immediate causation or suppression. If the signature declares e e causable ( e ∈ ℂ e\in\mathbb{C} ), then e e is enforced by an unconditional clause that causes e ⁡ ( t ¯ ) e(\bar{t}) ; if it declares e e suppressable ( e ∈ 𝕊 e\in\mathbb{S} ), the clause fires exactly when e ⁡ ( t ¯ ) e(\bar{t}) is present and suppresses it. The Let rules assert a fresh obligation event 𝙲𝚊𝚞 ​ _ ​ e \mathtt{Cau}\_e (resp. 𝚂𝚞𝚙 ​ _ ​ e \mathtt{Sup}\_e ), of the same arity as e e , that will be consumed by clauses that realize e e ’s body. The Neg rule flips the target formula’s polarity: causing ¬ φ \neg\varphi is suppressing φ \varphi ( ℂ ¯ = 𝕊 \bar{\mathbb{C}}=\mathbb{S} , 𝕊 ¯ = ℂ \bar{\mathbb{S}}=\mathbb{C} ). To cause a conjunction ( And C ), every conjunct must be caused, so the clause sets are combined by the product ⨂ \bigotimes ; to suppress it ( And S ) it suffices to falsify one conjunct φ j \varphi_{j} , with the other conjuncts added to the filter. To cause ∃ x . φ \exists x.\,\varphi ( Ex C ), the rule substitutes a canonical value 0 0 for x x . To suppress it ( Ex S ), every witness must be falsified, hence x x must be guarded.
paragraphs.zh: 两条 Ev 规则是唯一实现即时因果或抑制的规则。 如果签名声明 e 是可因果的（e ∈ ℂ），则 e 会由一个无条件子句强制执行，该子句引发 e⁡(t¯)；如果签名声明 e 是可抑制的（e ∈ 𝕊），则该子句仅在 e⁡(t¯) 存在时触发并抑制它。 Let 规则断言一个新的义务事件 𝙲𝚊𝚞​_​e（相应地，𝚂𝚞𝚙​_​e），其元数与 e 相同，并将被用于实现 e 主体的子句所消耗。 Neg 规则会翻转目标公式的极性：引发 ¬φ 即抑制 φ（ℂ¯ = 𝕊，𝕊¯ = ℂ）。 要引发一个合取式（And C），每个合取项都必须被引发，因此子句集通过乘积 ⨂ 组合；要抑制它（And S），只需使其中一个合取项 φj 为假，其余合取项则加入过滤器。 要引发 ∃x.φ（Ex C），该规则会用典范值 0 替换 x。 要抑制它（Ex S），每个见证都必须被证伪，因此 x 必须受到约束。

paragraphs.en: TypeLet performs a case split on the let body’s outermost operator. Each case decides guardedness g g and computes the two clause families by rewriting the relevant operand and gating it with p p ’s obligation event. The boolean c c (resp. s s ) can be computed by checking the emptiness of the set of causation (resp. suppression) clauses. Which clauses are generated depends on the topmost operator of the let. A ⧫ \operatorname{\blacklozenge} or 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}} is causable only when its interval admits the present ( a = 0 a=0 ) by causing the (right) operand; a 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}} is suppressable when either a > 0 a>0 and its left operand is suppressable or both its operands are. A ● \mathop{\CIRCLE}\nolimits or aggregation is neither causable or suppressable. Insufficient guarding is fatal for a temporal or aggregation let. For any other let, it downgrades p p to filter-only , making it usable as a boolean condition but not caused or suppressed.
paragraphs.zh: TypeLet 对 let 主体的最外层算子执行一次情况划分。 每种情况都会决定受保护性 g g，并通过重写相关操作数并用 p p 的义务事件对其进行门控来计算两个子句族。 布尔值 c c（或 s s）可以通过检查因果（或抑制）子句集合是否为空来计算。 生成哪些子句取决于 let 的最顶层算子。 A ⧫ \operatorname{\blacklozenge} 或 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}} 仅在区间允许当前状态（ a = 0 a=0 ）并通过因果作用于（右）操作数时才是可因果的；一个 𝖲 \mathbin{\mathsf{S}} 在以下情况中是可抑制的：a > 0 a>0 且其左操作数可抑制，或者其两个操作数均可抑制。 A ● \mathop{\CIRCLE}\nolimits 或聚合既不可因果也不可抑制。 对于临时 let 或聚合 let，保护不足是致命的。 对于任何其他 let，这会将 p p 降级为仅过滤模式，使其可作为布尔条件使用，但不会被因果作用或抑制。

paragraphs.en: Not all candidate clause sets generated in the previous step yield a sound enforcer. For example, the set C 1 = { ( ⊤ , ⊤ ) ⇒ A ( 0 ) , ( ⊤ , ⊤ ) ⇒ ¬ A ( 0 ) } C_{1}=\{(\top,\top)\Rightarrow A(0),(\top,\top)\Rightarrow\neg A(0)\} is unsatisfiable, while C 2 = { ( A ( x ) , ⊤ ) ⇒ A ( x + 1 ) } C_{2}=\{(A(x),\top)\Rightarrow A(x+1)\} generates an infinite number of events and never terminates. We state two checks that together guarantee that a set of clauses can be finitely enforced. The first rules out events that are simultaneously caused and suppressed, as in C 1 C_{1} ; the second rules out non-termination, as in C 2 C_{2} .

paragraphs.en: We implement the compilation of Section 4 and the EF interpreter of Section 3 in a tool called EnfFlash . The compiler (7k LOC of OCaml) parses an MFOTL specification, runs let-normalization, guard extraction, enforcement rewriting, and the dependency analysis, discharges the cause/suppress checks with Z3, and emits an EF program. The interpreter (4k LOC of Rust) loads the EF program, computes a bound on its complexity as in Section 3 , and exposes the reactive and proactive entry points μ \mu and ν \nu . We use Rust’s pyo3 Python bindings to evaluate user-defined functions. EnfFlash is open-source and available online . Our evaluation answers four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在名为 EnfFlash 的工具中实现了第 4 节的编译器和第 3 节的 EF 解释器。 该编译器（7k 行 OCaml 代码）会解析 MFOTL 规范，执行 let-归一化、守卫提取、强制重写和依赖分析，使用 Z3 验证原因/抑制检查，并生成一个 EF 程序。 该解释器（4k 行 Rust 代码）会加载 EF 程序，计算其复杂度的界限（如第 3 节所述），并提供反应式与主动式入口点 μ \mu 和 ν \nu。 我们使用 Rust 的 pyo3 Python 绑定来评估用户定义函数。 EnfFlash 是开源的，并且可以在线获取。 我们的评估回答了四个研究问题：

sents.en: We implement the compilation of Section 4 and the EF interpreter of Section 3 in a tool called EnfFlash .
sents.zh: 我们在名为 EnfFlash 的工具中实现了第 4 节的编译器和第 3 节的 EF 解释器。

sents.en: The compiler (7k LOC of OCaml) parses an MFOTL specification, runs let-normalization, guard extraction, enforcement rewriting, and the dependency analysis, discharges the cause/suppress checks with Z3, and emits an EF program.
sents.zh: 该编译器（7k 行 OCaml 代码）会解析 MFOTL 规范，执行 let-归一化、守卫提取、强制重写和依赖分析，使用 Z3 验证原因/抑制检查，并生成一个 EF 程序。

sents.en: The interpreter (4k LOC of Rust) loads the EF program, computes a bound on its complexity as in Section 3 , and exposes the reactive and proactive entry points μ \mu and ν \nu .
sents.zh: 该解释器（4k 行 Rust 代码）会加载 EF 程序，计算其复杂度的界限（如第 3 节所述），并提供反应式与主动式入口点 μ \mu 和 ν \nu。

sents.en: We use Rust’s pyo3 Python bindings to evaluate user-defined functions.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Rust 的 pyo3 Python 绑定来评估用户定义函数。

sents.en: EnfFlash is open-source and available online .
sents.zh: EnfFlash 是开源的，并且可以在线获取。

sents.en: Our evaluation answers four research questions:
sents.zh: 我们的评估回答了四个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: (Expressiveness) Does EnfFlash support the specifications of existing benchmarks and real applications?
paragraphs.zh: （表现力）EnfFlash 是否支持现有基准测试和实际应用中的规范？

paragraphs.en: (Latency) How does EnfFlash ’s latency compare to state-of-the-art first-order enforcers?
paragraphs.zh: （延迟）EnfFlash 的延迟与当前最先进的单步执行器相比如何？

paragraphs.en: (Overhead in web applications) Is the end-to-end enforcement overhead small enough for user-facing operations in web applications?
paragraphs.zh: （网络应用中的开销）端到端的执行开销是否足够小，以支持网络应用中面向用户的操作？

paragraphs.en: (Comparison with permission engines) How does EnfFlash compare to a state-of-the-art non-temporal permission engine (Cedar) and its temporal extension (Dogwood) on access control, accounting for the cost of maintaining temporal state?
paragraphs.zh: （与权限引擎的对比）在访问控制方面，考虑到维护临时状态的成本，EnfFlash 与当前最先进的非临时性权限引擎（Cedar）及其临时性扩展（Dogwood）相比表现如何？

paragraphs.en: All experiments run under Ubuntu 24.04.3 on an Intel Core Ultra 7 165U with 12 cores and 32GB of RAM. We run two types of experiments: tool-only benchmarks, where a trace from an existing benchmark is replayed to enforcement tools; and application benchmarks, where those tools serve as Policy Decision Points (PDP) for web applications ( Hublet et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均在 Ubuntu 24.04.3 系统上运行，硬件为配备 12 个核心和 32GB RAM 的 Intel Core Ultra 7 165U。 我们运行了两种类型的实验：仅工具基准测试（即重播现有基准测试中的轨迹以执行给定的工具）和应用基准测试（即这些工具充当网络应用的策略决策点（PDP）（Hublet et al., 2025a））。

sents.en: All experiments run under Ubuntu 24.04.3 on an Intel Core Ultra 7 165U with 12 cores and 32GB of RAM.
sents.zh: 所有实验均在 Ubuntu 24.04.3 系统上运行，硬件为配备 12 个核心和 32GB RAM 的 Intel Core Ultra 7 165U。

sents.en: We run two types of experiments: tool-only benchmarks, where a trace from an existing benchmark is replayed to enforcement tools; and application benchmarks, where those tools serve as Policy Decision Points (PDP) for web applications ( Hublet et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: 我们运行了两种类型的实验：仅工具基准测试（即重播现有基准测试中的轨迹以执行给定的工具）和应用基准测试（即这些工具充当网络应用的策略决策点（PDP）（Hublet et al., 2025a））。

paragraphs.en: In tool-only benchmarks, latency is measured as wall-clock time for the processing of single time points. We report per-time-point average and maximum latency for each run.
paragraphs.zh: 在仅使用工具的基准测试中，延迟是指处理单个时间点所需的实际耗时。 我们对每次运行报告每个时间点的平均延迟和最大延迟。

sents.en: In tool-only benchmarks, latency is measured as wall-clock time for the processing of single time points.
sents.zh: 在仅使用工具的基准测试中，延迟是指处理单个时间点所需的实际耗时。

sents.en: We report per-time-point average and maximum latency for each run.
sents.zh: 我们对每次运行报告每个时间点的平均延迟和最大延迟。

paragraphs.en: In application benchmarks, we measure full round-trip page latency using Python’s requests library against a local server with the ‘performance’ CPU governor activated.
paragraphs.zh: 在应用基准测试中，我们使用 Python 的 requests 库，针对启用了“性能”CPU 调度器的本地服务器，测量完整的页面往返延迟。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate EnfFlash on EnfGuard ’s six enforcement benchmarks, spanning data protection ( gdpr , fun ), aggregation-heavy policies ( agg ), fault clustering ( cluster ), infrastructure monitoring ( ic ), and database updates in a large system ( nokia ). We use all formulae in the benchmark with the largest available log. For each, we compile the specification and replay ( Krstić and Schneider, 2020 ) the provided traces in real time, measuring latency against EnfFlash , EnfGuard ( Hublet et al., 2025b ) , EnfPoly ( Hublet et al., 2022 ) , MonPoly ( Basin et al., 2011 ) , and Dogwood ( Brooker et al., ) on identical inputs, with 3 repetitions. We selected EnfGuard and EnfPoly as the two fastest available MFOTL enforcers. MonPoly is an optimized MFOTL monitor , i.e. a tool that identifies but does not correct policy violations. Although MonPoly is therefore not a direct competitor to enforcement tools, it provides a challenging state-of-the-art latency baseline for a slightly simpler problem. Dogwood is a recent extension of Cedar with past-time temporal conditions over an event history. It supports suppression but no causation, and its temporal conditions are past-only, with bounded windows, no disjunction, and aggregations limited to counts and sums of integers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在 EnfGuard 的六个执行基准上评估 EnfFlash，这些基准涵盖数据保护（gdpr、fun）、聚合密集型策略（agg）、故障聚类（cluster）、基础设施监控（ic）以及大型系统中的数据库更新（nokia）。 我们使用基准中所有公式，并采用可用的最大日志。 对于每个基准，我们都会编译规范，并以实时方式重放（Krstić 和 Schneider，2020）提供的轨迹，在相同输入条件下测量其延迟，并与 EnfFlash、EnfGuard（Hublet 等，2025b）、EnfPoly（Hublet 等，2022）、MonPoly（Basin 等，2011）和 Dogwood（Brooker 等，）进行对比，重复实验 3 次。 我们选择了 EnfGuard 和 EnfPoly 作为目前最快的两种 MFOTL 执行工具。 MonPoly 是一种经过优化的 MFOTL 监控器，即一种仅能识别但不能纠正策略违规行为的工具。 因此，尽管 MonPoly 并非执行工具的直接竞争对手，但它为略微简单的问题提供了一个具有挑战性的当前最佳延迟基准。 Dogwood 是 Cedar 的一项近期扩展，支持针对事件历史的时间条件。 它支持抑制操作但不支持因果性分析，其时间条件仅基于过去事件，且窗口有界、不支持析取，聚合操作也仅限于整数的计数和求和。

sents.en: Although MonPoly is therefore not a direct competitor to enforcement tools, it provides a challenging state-of-the-art latency baseline for a slightly simpler problem.
sents.zh: 因此，尽管 MonPoly 并非执行工具的直接竞争对手，但它为略微简单的问题提供了一个具有挑战性的当前最佳延迟基准。

sents.en: Dogwood is a recent extension of Cedar with past-time temporal conditions over an event history.
sents.zh: Dogwood 是 Cedar 的一项近期扩展，支持针对事件历史的时间条件。

sents.en: It supports suppression but no causation, and its temporal conditions are past-only, with bounded windows, no disjunction, and aggregations limited to counts and sums of integers.
sents.zh: 它支持抑制操作但不支持因果性分析，其时间条件仅基于过去事件，且窗口有界、不支持析取，聚合操作也仅限于整数的计数和求和。

paragraphs.en: Dogwood supports only 11 of the 40 formulae: other formulae require causing events (the deletion formulae and cluster ), future operators ( nokia ’s del and ins formulae), user-defined functions ( fun ), or aggregations other than sums and counts ( agg ’s p4–p6). On these, Dogwood is within 12% of EnfFlash on 4, 2.4–17 × \times slower on 3, 3.6 × \times faster on 1, and times out on 3. EnfFlash supports all policies in the benchmarks, with only the nokia formulae require rewriting to avoid nesting past and future operators. It processes 39 of the 40 within the timeout while EnfGuard processes 21. On 17 of the 20 processed by both, EnfFlash ’s average latency is 3–44 × \times lower than EnfGuard ’s, which is faster on 2 ic formulae (1.4 × \times , 7 × \times ). EnfPoly , which supports only 7 formulae, is 1.3–2.3 × \times faster than EnfFlash on 5 nokia formulae. EnfFlash is within 4 × \times of MonPoly on the 27 formulae processed by both (1.1–1.8 × \times faster on gdpr , up to 3.8 × \times slower on agg and nokia ); MonPoly times out on 4 ic formulae.Average (resp. max) latency is 0.08–3.8 ms (resp. 1–98 ms), below 1 ms on 36 formulae.
paragraphs.zh: Dogwood 仅支持 40 个公式中的 11 个：其他公式需要触发事件（删除公式和簇）、未来算子（nokia 的 del 和 ins 公式）、用户定义函数（fun），或除求和与计数之外的聚合操作（agg 的 p4–p6）。 在这些公式中，Dogwood 在 4 个公式上的性能与 EnfFlash 相差 12% 以内，在 3 个公式上慢 2.4–17 倍，在 1 个公式上快 3.6 倍，另有 3 个公式超时。 EnfFlash 支持基准测试中的所有策略，只有 nokia 公式需要重写以避免将过去和未来的算子嵌套使用。 它在超时时间内处理了 40 个公式中的 39 个，而 EnfGuard 仅处理了 21 个。 在双方都处理的 20 个公式中的 17 个上，EnfFlash 的平均延迟比 EnfGuard 低 3–44 倍；EnfGuard 在 2 个 ic 公式上更快（分别快 1.4 倍和 7 倍）。 EnfPoly 仅支持 7 个公式，但在 5 个 nokia 公式上的速度比 EnfFlash 快 1.3–2.3 倍。 在双方都处理的 27 个公式上，EnfFlash 的性能与 MonPoly 相差 4 倍以内（gdpr 上快 1.1–1.8 倍，agg 和 nokia 上慢至多 3.8 倍）；MonPoly 在 4 个 ic 公式上超时。平均（及最大）延迟为 0.08–3.8 毫秒（及 1–98 毫秒），其中 36 个公式的延迟低于 1 毫秒。

sents.zh: Dogwood 仅支持 40 个公式中的 11 个：其他公式需要触发事件（删除公式和簇）、未来算子（nokia 的 del 和 ins 公式）、用户定义函数（fun），或除求和与计数之外的聚合操作（agg 的 p4–p6）。

paragraphs.en: Our first deployment instruments GDPRSocial , a microblogging app implemented in ca. 2.5k LOC of Python/Django that runs against an extensive GDPR specification encoded as a 400-line MFOTL formula. The GDPR specification is intrinsically temporal , with both statefulness (consent and revocation thereof must be persisted) and proactivity (personal data must be accessed, rectified, or deleted in a timely manner when users require it). EnfFlash acts as an enforcement backend invoked through the Instrlib ( Hublet et al., 2025a ) library. We measure the latency of a set of representative application views: accessing a user’s timeline, posting a message, giving or revoking consent for personalized advertisement, viewing privacy notices, and requesting access to one’s data. Measurements are performed for n ∈ { 10 2 , 10 3 , 10 4 , 10 5 } n\in\{10^{2},10^{3},10^{4},10^{5}\} posts by n / 100 n/100 users over 10 repetitions after 5 warm-up calls. As a baseline, we perform measurements on a copy of the app stripped of all enforcement. Note that due to the temporal nature of the policy and the much higher latency of EnfGuard , no systematic experiments could be performed with competing tools. Dogwood cannot express the specification, as it requires causing events (e.g., deleting or providing personal data upon request).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的首次部署采用了 GDPRSocial，这是一款用约 2500 行 Python/Django 代码实现的微博客应用，它基于一个以 400 行 MFOTL 公式编码的详尽 GDPR 规范运行。 GDPR 规范本质上具有时间性，既包含状态保持特性（同意及其撤销必须被持久化存储），也包含主动性特性（当用户需要时，个人数据必须及时被访问、更正或删除）。 EnfFlash 充当执行后端，通过 Instrlib（Hublet 等，2025a）库进行调用。 我们测量了一系列代表性应用视图的延迟：访问用户的时间线、发布消息、同意或撤销个性化广告授权、查看隐私声明，以及请求访问自身数据。 测量针对 n ∈ {10², 10³, 10⁴, 10⁵} 个帖子进行，由 n/100 名用户在经过 5 次预热调用后重复 10 次实验。 作为基准，我们对一个移除了所有执行功能的应用副本进行了测量。 需要注意的是，由于该策略的时间性特征以及 EnfGuard 明显更高的延迟，我们无法使用其他竞争工具开展系统性实验。 Dogwood 无法表达该规范，因为它需要触发事件（例如，在请求时删除或提供个人数据）。

sents.en: Our first deployment instruments GDPRSocial , a microblogging app implemented in ca. 2.5k LOC of Python/Django that runs against an extensive GDPR specification encoded as a 400-line MFOTL formula.
sents.zh: 我们的首次部署采用了 GDPRSocial，这是一款用约 2500 行 Python/Django 代码实现的微博客应用，它基于一个以 400 行 MFOTL 公式编码的详尽 GDPR 规范运行。

sents.en: The GDPR specification is intrinsically temporal , with both statefulness (consent and revocation thereof must be persisted) and proactivity (personal data must be accessed, rectified, or deleted in a timely manner when users require it).
sents.zh: GDPR 规范本质上具有时间性，既包含状态保持特性（同意及其撤销必须被持久化存储），也包含主动性特性（当用户需要时，个人数据必须及时被访问、更正或删除）。

sents.en: EnfFlash acts as an enforcement backend invoked through the Instrlib ( Hublet et al., 2025a ) library.
sents.zh: EnfFlash 充当执行后端，通过 Instrlib（Hublet 等，2025a）库进行调用。

sents.en: We measure the latency of a set of representative application views: accessing a user’s timeline, posting a message, giving or revoking consent for personalized advertisement, viewing privacy notices, and requesting access to one’s data.
sents.zh: 我们测量了一系列代表性应用视图的延迟：访问用户的时间线、发布消息、同意或撤销个性化广告授权、查看隐私声明，以及请求访问自身数据。

sents.en: Measurements are performed for n ∈ { 10 2 , 10 3 , 10 4 , 10 5 } n\in\{10^{2},10^{3},10^{4},10^{5}\} posts by n / 100 n/100 users over 10 repetitions after 5 warm-up calls.
sents.zh: 测量针对 n ∈ {10², 10³, 10⁴, 10⁵} 个帖子进行，由 n/100 名用户在经过 5 次预热调用后重复 10 次实验。

sents.en: As a baseline, we perform measurements on a copy of the app stripped of all enforcement.
sents.zh: 作为基准，我们对一个移除了所有执行功能的应用副本进行了测量。

sents.en: Note that due to the temporal nature of the policy and the much higher latency of EnfGuard , no systematic experiments could be performed with competing tools.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，由于该策略的时间性特征以及 EnfGuard 明显更高的延迟，我们无法使用其他竞争工具开展系统性实验。

sents.en: Dogwood cannot express the specification, as it requires causing events (e.g., deleting or providing personal data upon request).
sents.zh: Dogwood 无法表达该规范，因为它需要触发事件（例如，在请求时删除或提供个人数据）。

paragraphs.en: EnfFlash supports the large input formula. All views load in 6–27 ms, with enforcement inducing an overhead of 1–15 ms with respect to the non-enforced baseline. This loading time would typically be perceived as instantaneous by users ( Nielsen, 1993 , p. 135) . In particular, runtime latency does not grow with n n , and hence enforcement scales well with database size.
paragraphs.zh: EnfFlash 支持大型输入公式。 所有视图的加载时间在 6–27 毫秒之间，其中强制执行相较于无强制的基准情况会带来 1–15 毫秒的额外开销。 这种加载时间通常会被用户感知为即时（Nielsen, 1993，第 135 页）。 特别是，运行时延迟不会随 n 增长，因此强制执行能够很好地适应数据库规模的扩大。

sents.en: EnfFlash supports the large input formula.
sents.zh: EnfFlash 支持大型输入公式。

sents.en: All views load in 6–27 ms, with enforcement inducing an overhead of 1–15 ms with respect to the non-enforced baseline.
sents.zh: 所有视图的加载时间在 6–27 毫秒之间，其中强制执行相较于无强制的基准情况会带来 1–15 毫秒的额外开销。

sents.en: This loading time would typically be perceived as instantaneous by users ( Nielsen, 1993 , p. 135) .
sents.zh: 这种加载时间通常会被用户感知为即时（Nielsen, 1993，第 135 页）。

sents.en: In particular, runtime latency does not grow with n n , and hence enforcement scales well with database size.
sents.zh: 特别是，运行时延迟不会随 n 增长，因此强制执行能够很好地适应数据库规模的扩大。

paragraphs.en:
Our second deployment is EventManager , an event-management platform whose access-control policy mixes role-based rules (e.g., only admins may add moderators) with stateful constraints (e.g., only event owners may promote an attendant of an event to manager of the event). This application was proposed by Basin et al. ( Basin et al., 2023 ) and implemented in both Cedar ( Cutler et al., 2024 ) and ν 
u ActionGUI ( Krstić et al., 2024 ) AC mechanisms. Because most of this policy is expressible without temporal operators when the roles are fixed, it admits a direct encoding in these two platforms, giving us two non-temporal baselines. However, the fact that these roles can change over time means that an extensive dynamic context must be passed to the non-temporal evaluator at every request, potentially increasing the latency. We straightforwardly translated the platform’s access control policy into ca. 150 lines of MFOTL by replacing all the predicates of the form 𝗁𝖺𝗌𝖱𝗈𝗅𝖾 ⁡ ( x ¯ ) \mathsf{hasRole}( ar{x}) by the ¬ 𝗅𝖾𝖿𝗍𝖱𝗈𝗅𝖾 ⁡ ( x ¯ ) 𝖲 𝖻𝖾𝖼𝗈𝗆𝖾𝖱𝗈𝗅𝖾 ⁡ ( x ¯ ) 
eg\mathsf{leftRole}( ar{x})\mathbin{\mathsf{S}}\mathsf{becomeRole}( ar{x}) formula. As a temporal baseline, we translated the MFOTL formula into Dogwood, which, unlike Cedar, also expresses the policy’s consent rules: each ¬ 𝗅𝖾𝖿𝗍𝖱𝗈𝗅𝖾 ⁡ ( x ¯ ) 𝖲 𝖻𝖾𝖼𝗈𝗆𝖾𝖱𝗈𝗅𝖾 ⁡ ( x ¯ ) 
eg\mathsf{leftRole}( ar{x})\mathbin{\mathsf{S}}\mathsf{becomeRole}( ar{x}) becomes a since condition, and each disjunction a separate permit . The Dogwood version of the application is otherwise identical to the EnfFlash one, with the same enforcement points and the same result cache. Measurements are performed for n ∈ { 1 , 10 , … , 10 4 } n\in\{1,10,\dots,10^{4}\} users and 10 ​ n 10n events; requests time out after 300 s (Cedar beyond n = 100 n=100 , ‘view events’ beyond n = 1000 n=1000 ).

sents.en: Measurements are performed for n ∈ { 1 , 10 , … , 10 4 } n\in\{1,10,\dots,10^{4}\} users and 10 ​ n 10n events; requests time out after 300 s (Cedar beyond n = 100 n=100 , ‘view events’ beyond n = 1000 n=1000 ).

paragraphs.en: Our EnfFlash implementation is faster than the Cedar baseline on 4 of 6 views and within 7 ms on the 2 consent views (where Cedar is up to 1.9 × \times faster), with 8–42 × \times and 88–123 × \times speedups on the ‘view events’ and ‘view profile’ pages, which query permissions about many entities. Dogwood is on par with EnfFlash up to n = 100 n=100 , but its latency grows faster with the history: for n ≥ 1000 n\geq 1000 , it is 1.6–3.5 × \times slower on 4 views (e.g., 3.0 × \times on ‘view profile’ at n = 10 4 n=10^{4} ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 6 个视图中，我们的 EnfFlash 实现比 Cedar 基线快 4 个；在 2 个同意视图中，性能差距在 7 毫秒以内（Cedar 在这些视图中的速度最多可达 1.9 × \times），而在“查看事件”和“查看个人资料”页面上，速度分别提升了 8–42 × \times 和 88–123 × \times，这些页面会查询多个实体的权限。 当 n = 100 n=100 时，Dogwood 的性能与 EnfFlash 相当，但其延迟随历史记录增长得更快：对于 n ≥ 1000 n\geq 1000 的情况，它在 4 个视图中的速度慢了 1.6–3.5 × \times（例如，在 n = 10^{4} 时，“查看个人资料”视图的速度慢了 3.0 × \times）。

paragraphs.en: Our third deployment enforces security policies on the tool calls of an LLM agent. We use the ‘banking’ suite of AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , an established benchmark for agentic security. In this suite, an agent operates a bank account using 11 tools (e.g., sending money, changing a password, reading files). The suite contains 16 benign and 144 attacked ground-truth runs, which we replay after translating all tool calls, tool outputs, and user prompts into log events. Each call is submitted to EnfFlash for approval before it executes, and suppressed calls are not executed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第三次部署对 LLM 智能体的工具调用强制执行安全策略。 我们使用 AgentDojo（Debenedetti 等人，2024）的“银行”套件，这是一个用于智能体安全的成熟基准。 在该套件中，一个智能体使用 11 种工具（例如：转账、更改密码、读取文件）来操作银行账户。 该套件包含 16 个良性运行和 144 个受攻击的基准运行，我们在将所有工具调用、工具输出和用户提示转换为日志事件后重新执行这些运行。 每次调用在执行前都会提交给 EnfFlash 进行审批，而被抑制的调用则不会被执行。

sents.en: Our third deployment enforces security policies on the tool calls of an LLM agent.
sents.zh: 我们的第三次部署对 LLM 智能体的工具调用强制执行安全策略。

sents.en: We use the ‘banking’ suite of AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , an established benchmark for agentic security.
sents.zh: 我们使用 AgentDojo（Debenedetti 等人，2024）的“银行”套件，这是一个用于智能体安全的成熟基准。

sents.en: In this suite, an agent operates a bank account using 11 tools (e.g., sending money, changing a password, reading files).
sents.zh: 在该套件中，一个智能体使用 11 种工具（例如：转账、更改密码、读取文件）来操作银行账户。

sents.en: The suite contains 16 benign and 144 attacked ground-truth runs, which we replay after translating all tool calls, tool outputs, and user prompts into log events.
sents.zh: 该套件包含 16 个良性运行和 144 个受攻击的基准运行，我们在将所有工具调用、工具输出和用户提示转换为日志事件后重新执行这些运行。

sents.en: Each call is submitted to EnfFlash for approval before it executes, and suppressed calls are not executed.
sents.zh: 每次调用在执行前都会提交给 EnfFlash 进行审批，而被抑制的调用则不会被执行。

paragraphs.en: We specify ten policies B1–B10 in MFOTL. For instance, B1 restricts payees to accounts mentioned by the user, paid before, or occurring in a file named by the user; B2 forbids payment subjects containing account data not supplied by the user; and B3 caps the amount sent to a payee within 24 hours at $10,000. All policies are first-order; they also use unbounded past operators (B1,2,7,10), aggregations over metric windows (B3,4), and causation (B5,6,8,9). In contrast, existing runtime guardrails for LLM agents check either single tool calls ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or propositional temporal properties ( Xiao and Nuzzo, 2026 ) . Dogwood cannot cause events: we translate B1–B8 and B10 into Dogwood (for B5, B6, and B8, only their suppression part), emulating unbounded past operators by 100-year windows as in Section 5.2 . We record the event log of each policy and replay it through EnfFlash , EnfGuard , and Dogwood one time point at a time, measuring latency as in Section 5.2 (timeout 600 s); on every log, the three tools suppress the same tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MFOTL 中定义了十项策略 B1–B10。 例如，B1 将收款人限制为用户提及、用户曾付款过或出现在用户指定文件名中的账户；B2 禁止支付主体包含用户未提供的账户数据；B3 则将 24 小时内向某位收款人发送的金额上限设为 10,000 美元。 所有策略均为一阶策略；它们还使用了无界过去算子（B1、B2、B7、B10）、指标窗口上的聚合（B3、B4）以及因果性（B5、B6、B8、B9）。 相比之下，现有针对 LLM 智能体的运行时防护机制要么检查单个工具调用（Wang et al., 2026），要么检查命题时态属性（Xiao and Nuzzo, 2026）。 Dogwood 无法引发事件：我们将 B1–B8 和 B10 转换为 Dogwood（对于 B5、B6 和 B8，仅转换其抑制部分），并通过如第 5.2 节所述的 100 年窗口来模拟无界过去算子。 我们记录每项策略的事件日志，并逐一时间点通过 EnfFlash、EnfGuard 和 Dogwood 重播该日志，测量延迟的方式与第 5.2 节相同（超时时间为 600 秒）；对于每个日志，这三种工具都会抑制相同的工具调用。

sents.en: We specify ten policies B1–B10 in MFOTL.
sents.zh: 我们在 MFOTL 中定义了十项策略 B1–B10。

sents.en: For instance, B1 restricts payees to accounts mentioned by the user, paid before, or occurring in a file named by the user; B2 forbids payment subjects containing account data not supplied by the user; and B3 caps the amount sent to a payee within 24 hours at $10,000.

paragraphs.en: EnfFlash supports all ten policies and their conjunction. None of the policies suppresses a call in a benign run. Without enforcement, 143 of the 144 attacks succeed; the conjunction prevents 142 of them, with B1 alone preventing 77 attacks. Average latency is 0.03–0.05 ms per time point for individual policies, and 0.08 ms for the conjunction of B1–B10. Dogwood can fully enforce 6 policies and partially enforce the suppression part of 3 additional ones (hollow markers in Figure 8 d). An additional experiment on a large log of 23,320 shows that latency grows sublinearly with history side (52 to 64 μ \mu s from the first to the last fifth of the run). EnfGuard is 20–5,570 × \times slower, while Dogwood is 1.8–16 × \times slower and 12 × \times slower on the conjunction.
paragraphs.zh: EnfFlash 支持全部十项策略及其联合应用。 在任何良性运行中，没有任何一项策略会抑制调用。 若无强制执行，144 次攻击中有 143 次会成功；而联合应用可阻止其中 142 次，仅 B1 一项即可阻止 77 次攻击。 单项策略的平均延迟为每个时间点 0.03–0.05 毫秒，B1–B10 联合应用的平均延迟为 0.08 毫秒。 Dogwood 能够完全执行 6 项策略，并部分执行另外 3 项策略的抑制部分（图 8d 中的空心标记）。 在包含 23,320 条记录的大型日志上进行的额外实验表明，延迟随历史侧数据呈亚线性增长（从运行首五分之一到末五分之一时，延迟从 52 μs 增至 64 μs）。 EnfGuard 的速度慢 20–5,570 倍，而 Dogwood 的速度慢 1.8–16 倍，在联合应用场景下则慢 12 倍。

sents.en: An additional experiment on a large log of 23,320 shows that latency grows sublinearly with history side (52 to 64 μ \mu s from the first to the last fifth of the run).
sents.zh: 在包含 23,320 条记录的大型日志上进行的额外实验表明，延迟随历史侧数据呈亚线性增长（从运行首五分之一到末五分之一时，延迟从 52 μs 增至 64 μs）。

sents.en: EnfGuard is 20–5,570 × \times slower, while Dogwood is 1.8–16 × \times slower and 12 × \times slower on the conjunction.
sents.zh: EnfGuard 的速度慢 20–5,570 倍，而 Dogwood 的速度慢 1.8–16 倍，在联合应用场景下则慢 12 倍。

paragraphs.en: EnfFlash supports all policies in the EnfGuard suite and the three application benchmarks, showing that the supported fragment of MFOTL is expressive enough to support a broad range of use cases (RQ1). Our tool achieves average per-event latency of 0.08–3.8 ms, 3–44 × \times lower than EnfGuard on 17 of the 20 formulae on which EnfGuard does not time out, and within 4 × \times of MonPoly , a monitor solving a substantially simpler problem (RQ2). On our LLM banking agent benchmark, EnfFlash enforces ten security policies with 0.03–0.08 ms average latency, 20–5,570 × \times faster than EnfGuard and 1.8–16 × \times faster than Dogwood, and prevents 142 of 143 successful prompt-injection attacks without suppressing any benign tool call (RQ1,2). In a real agentic deployment, EnfFlash ’s sub-millisecond latency would be dominated by the costs of inference. In the GDPRSocial application, enforcement adds 1–15 ms of overhead despite the policy’s complexity (400 LOC), and this overhead does not significantly change with database size, keeping all views near-instantaneous (RQ3). EnfFlash matches or significantly improves on Cedar’s performance in our EventManager application, up to 3.5 × \times faster than Dogwood on long histories and up to 123 × \times faster than Cedar’s full reload-and-evaluate pipeline in dynamic contexts (RQ4).

paragraphs.en: Runtime enforcement was introduced by Schneider in his seminal work on security automata ( Schneider, 2000 ) . Enforcement initially focused on execution cutting, i.e., terminating a system to prevent violations. Suppression ( Bauer et al., 2002 ; Fredrikson et al., 2012 ) and edit automata ( Ligatti et al., 2005 ) were later introduced to allow for suppression and causation of events, respectively. However, these enforcers were still allowed to (unrealistically) buffer events before making decisions. This capability was later dropped ( Ngo et al., 2015 ) , and other capabilities, such as delaying events ( Pinisetty et al., 2014 ; Falcone et al., 2016 ) and code inspection ( Pinisetty et al., 2017 ) , were considered. In parallel, fine-grained enforcer capabilities were introduced, distinguishing between causable or suppressable and only-observable events ( Basin et al., 2013 ) . Time-aware enforcers rely on timed automata as both a policy language and mechanism ( Falcone et al., 2021 ; Falcone and Pinisetty, 2019 ; Pinisetty et al., 2015 ; Renard et al., 2017 ) or as the translation target for logics such as MITL ( Maler et al., 2006 ) . The first proactive enforcement algorithm was developed for DCR graphs ( Basin et al., 2024 ) , a propositional formalism ( Hildebrandt et al., 2013 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Schneider 在其关于安全自动机的开创性著作（Schneider, 2000）中引入了运行时强制执行机制。 强制执行最初专注于执行截断，即终止系统以防止违规行为。 随后，研究者引入了抑制机制（Bauer et al., 2002; Fredrikson et al., 2012）和编辑自动机（Ligatti et al., 2005），分别用于抑制事件和引发事件。 然而，这些强制执行器仍然被允许在做出决策前（不切实际地）缓冲事件。 这一能力后来被取消（Ngo et al., 2015），而其他能力则被纳入考虑，例如延迟事件（Pinisetty et al., 2014; Falcone et al., 2016）和代码检查（Pinisetty et al., 2017）。 与此同时，研究者引入了更精细的强制执行能力，区分了可引发、可抑制和仅可观测的事件（Basin et al., 2013）。 时间感知强制执行器依赖定时自动机，既将其用作策略语言和机制（Falcone et al., 2021; Falcone and Pinisetty, 2019; Pinisetty et al., 2015; Renard et al., 2017），也用作 MITL 等逻辑的转换目标（Maler et al., 2006）。 首个主动强制执行算法是为 DCR 图（Basin et al., 2024）开发的，这是一种命题形式化方法（Hildebrandt et al., 2013）。

paragraphs.en: First-order temporal enforcers exist for LTL-FO + , a first-order variant of future-only LTL ( Hallé and Villemaire, 2012 ) , first-order Hennessy-Milner Logic with recursion (non-metric, suppression-only) ( Aceto et al., 2023a ; Aceto et al., 2023b ) , as well as for several fragments of MFOTL, both past-only ( Hublet et al., 2022 ) and with past and future ( Hublet et al., 2024 ; Hublet et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于未来限定型 LTL 的一阶变体（Hallé 和 Villemaire，2012）、带递归的一阶 Hennessy-Milner 逻辑（非度量、仅抑制）（Aceto 等，2023a；Aceto 等，2023b），以及 MFOTL 的若干片段——包括仅过去型（Hublet 等，2022）和同时包含过去与未来型（Hublet 等，2024；Hublet 等，2025b）——都存在一阶时间执行智能体。

paragraphs.en: Runtime enforcement as presented here is generic and thus provides theoretical underpinning for tools in many specialized domains, like access and usage control ( Krstić et al., 2024 ; Cutler et al., 2024 ) , Android permission management ( Sadeghi et al., 2018 ) , IoT ( Celik et al., 2019 ) , and LLM agent security ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , modulo appropriate instrumentation ( Hublet et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出的运行时执行机制具有通用性，因此为许多专业领域的工具提供了理论依据，例如访问与使用控制（Krstić 等，2024；Cutler 等，2024）、Android 权限管理（Sadeghi 等，2018）、物联网（Celik 等，2019）以及 LLM 智能体安全（Wang 等，2026），前提是进行适当的工具化集成（Hublet 等，2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Recent years have seen intense research activity around runtime guardrails for LLM agents. Most enforcers in this space inspect each call in isolation: AgentSpec ( Wang et al., 2026 ) evaluates trigger–predicate–action rules; Progent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) and Conseca ( Tsai and Bagdasarian, 2025 ) restrict tool names and arguments to those needed by the user’s task; and CaMeL ( Debenedetti et al., 2026 ) and FIDES ( Costa et al., 2025 ) track the provenance of values through capabilities and information-flow labels. LLM-based guards ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) give no deterministic guarantees. Few systems support temporal policies: Agent-C ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) and VIGIL ( Li et al., 2026 ) check ordering constraints on the trace with an SMT solver, FORGE ( Palumbo et al., 2026 ) evaluates Datalog policies, ContrAgent ( Xiao and Nuzzo, 2026 ) enforces assume-guarantee contracts in propositional LTL f with counters, and C-Trace ( Kahani et al., 2026 ) checks GDPR requirements expressed in MFOTL on agent traces. Amazon’s Bedrock AgentCore supports history-dependent policies written in Dogwood ( Amazon Web Services, 2026 ; Brooker et al., ) . None of these systems enforces real-time constraints over data-carrying events by both suppressing and causing events, e.g., limiting the amount sent to each payee within 24 hours while notifying the account owner of every sensitive change, as in our banking case study (Section 5.5 ). Table 1 summarizes these differences.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，围绕大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的运行时护栏展开了密集的研究。 该领域的大多数执行器都以孤立方式检查每次调用：AgentSpec（Wang 等，2026）评估触发–谓词–动作规则；Progent（Shi 等，2025）和 Conseca（Tsai 和 Bagdasarian，2025）将工具名称和参数限制为用户任务所需的范围；而 CaMeL（Debenedetti 等，2026）和 FIDES（Costa 等，2025）则通过能力与信息流标签追踪数值的来源。 基于 LLM 的护栏（Xiang 等，2024；Chen 等，2025）无法提供确定性的保证。 很少有系统支持时间相关的策略：Agent-C（Kamath 等，2025）和 VIGIL（Li 等，2026）使用 SMT 求解器检查轨迹中的顺序约束；FORGE（Palumbo 等，2026）评估 Datalog 策略；ContrAgent（Xiao 和 Nuzzo，2026）通过计数器在命题 LTL f 中执行假设-保证契约；而 C-Trace（Kahani 等，2026）则检查以 MFOTL 表达的 GDPR 要求对智能体轨迹的约束。 Amazon 的 Bedrock AgentCore 支持使用 Dogwood 编写的依赖历史记录的策略（Amazon Web Services，2026；Brooker 等）。 这些系统中没有任何一个能够通过对携带数据的事件进行抑制和触发来强制执行实时约束，例如，在 24 小时内限制发送给每位收款人的金额，同时向账户所有者通知每一项敏感变更，正如我们在银行案例研究（第 5.5 节）中所展示的那样。 表 1 总结了这些差异。

paragraphs.en: We presented EnfFlash , a novel first-order enforcer that is one to two orders of magnitude faster than the previous state-of-the-art, with comparable expressivity. EnfFlash is also up to an order of magnitude faster than the recently proposed Dogwood tool, developed for agentic security tasks; moreover, it is substantially more expressive and scales better with large logs. Even when deployed with very large policies, such as a 400-line MFOTL formula in a web application, EnfFlash induces only 1–15 ms of overhead. These results support the thesis that first-order runtime enforcement tools have become a mature alternative to ad-hoc frameworks for software security, including in the rapidly evolving field of agent security.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EnfFlash，这是一种新颖的一阶执行器，其速度比此前最先进的技术快一到两个数量级，同时具有相当的表达能力。 EnfFlash 也比最近为智能体安全任务开发的 Dogwood 工具快一个数量级；此外，它的表达能力更强，并且能更好地处理大型日志。 即使在部署于规模极大的策略（例如 Web 应用中一个包含 400 行的 MFOTL 公式）时，EnfFlash 也只会引入 1–15 毫秒的额外开销。 这些结果支持这样一个论点：一阶运行时执行工具已成为软件安全领域替代临时性框架的成熟方案，在快速演变的智能体安全领域也不例外。

paragraphs.en: The fragment enforced by EnfFlash is defined implicitly by the compilation of Section 4 : a formula is supported if let-normalization, TypeLet , and the enforcement rewriting succeed. We now characterize this fragment by a type system over formulae in let-normal form, which we call EF-MFOTL, and show that typability coincides with successful compilation.
paragraphs.zh: EnfFlash 所强制执行的片段由第 4 节的编译过程隐式定义：如果 let-归一化、TypeLet 和执行重写均成功，则一个公式受到支持。 我们现在通过一个针对 let-归一形式公式的类型系统来描述该片段，我们称之为 EF-MFOTL，并证明类型可判定性与成功编译是等价的。

sents.zh: 我们现在通过一个针对 let-归一形式公式的类型系统来描述该片段，我们称之为 EF-MFOTL，并证明类型可判定性与成功编译是等价的。

paragraphs.en: A formula □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi is in EF-MFOTL with clause set Δ \Delta if its let-normal form, with lets typed by some context Γ \Gamma as above, satisfies Γ ⊢ χ : ℂ ⊳ Δ \Gamma\vdash\chi:\mathbb{C}\triangleright\Delta .
paragraphs.zh: 一个公式 □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi 属于带有子句集 Δ \Delta 的 EF-MFOTL，当且仅当其 let 正常形式（其中 let 由如上某个上下文 Γ \Gamma 类型化）满足 Γ ⊢ χ : ℂ ⊳ Δ \Gamma\vdash\chi:\mathbb{C}\triangleright\Delta。

paragraphs.en: □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi is in EF-MFOTL with clause set Δ \Delta iff the compilation of Section 4 succeeds on □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi with candidate clause set Δ \Delta , i.e., TypeLet accepts all lets, and Γ ⊢ χ ↪ ℂ 𝒞 \Gamma\vdash\chi\hookrightarrow^{\mathbb{C}}\mathcal{C} for the resulting Γ \Gamma and some 𝒞 ∋ Δ \mathcal{C}\ni\Delta . [ Theorem_A_2 ]
paragraphs.zh: □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi 在子句集 Δ \Delta 下属于 EF-MFOTL，当且仅当第 4 节的编译过程对 □ ⁡ φ \operatorname{\square}\varphi 使用候选子句集 Δ \Delta 时成功，也就是说，TypeLet 接受所有 let 语句，并且对于所得到的 Γ \Gamma 和某个 𝒞 ∋ Δ \mathcal{C}\ni\Delta ，有 Γ ⊢ χ ↪ ℂ 𝒞 \Gamma\vdash\chi\hookrightarrow^{\mathbb{C}}\mathcal{C}。[ Theorem_A_2 ]

paragraphs.en: The rules of Figure 10 mirror those of Figure 5 , producing a single clause set instead of a set of alternatives: by induction on derivations, Γ ⊢ φ : α ⊳ Δ \Gamma\vdash\varphi:\alpha\triangleright\Delta iff Γ ⊢ φ ↪ α 𝒞 \Gamma\vdash\varphi\hookrightarrow^{\alpha}\mathcal{C} for some 𝒞 ∋ Δ \mathcal{C}\ni\Delta . The side condition of Ex S is equivalent to that of the rewrite rule by Lemma B.1 (1), and the enumerability conditions on let bodies are equivalent to the success of Guards \mathrm{Guards} by Lemma B.1 (2). Given a typing, the guards and realizations are obtained from the typing derivations of the let bodies; conversely, capabilities are read off the guards and realizations computed by TypeLet . ∎

paragraphs.en: Together with Theorem 4.4 , every formula of EF-MFOTL whose clause set passes the checks of Section 4.5 is soundly enforced by the compiled EF program. Lemma B.1 and Theorem B.3 are formalized in Lean 4, together with the soundness of compilation and of the enforcement loop.
